breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a long preamble with contradictory definitions for the spatial grid setup (Nx and dx). The ground truth resolved this by removing the contradictory sentences. The agent's generated specification also resolved this by completely omitting the confusing preamble and stating only the single, correct grid definition from the 'Numerical method requirements' section, which is consistent with the ground truth.
